title: Elderly Couple Holding Baby Outdoors, 1940s Vintage Snapshot Photo
description: An intimate full-length outdoor portrait of an older couple proudly holding an infant outdoors against a simple rural or suburban fence line. The grandfather, dressed in a dark three-piece suit with wire-rimmed glasses, holds a cane and clutches a lit cigarette between his lips while securely holding the baby. The grandmother, wearing round dark-rimmed glasses and a tailored mid-century collared dress with a ribbon accent, looks adoringly at the child. The back of the print reveals remnants of black paper album mounting at the corners.
